About this item

  • Super Bright & Eye-Caring: This LED desk lamp features a dual-head design for a wider lighting range, delivering high brightness while remaining soft and flicker-free; Reduces eye strain, making it ideal for home office, reading, studying, and long work sessions
  • Customizable Lighting & Memory Function: Offers 5 color temperatures (3000K-6500K) and 5 brightness levels (20%-100%) for personalized illumination; Smart memory function retains the last-used setting for added convenience
  • Flexible Goose-Neck & Space-Saving Design: Adjustable goose-neck allows precise light positioning; Compact clamp design saves desk space while providing bright and efficient lighting for tasks like reading, writing, crafting, and working
  • Remote & Button Control with Timer: Adjust brightness and color with a remote (up to 32.8 ft/10 m range) or on-lamp button controls; 1-hour timer function automatically turns off the light, perfect for home office setups and study sessions
  • Durable & Energy-Efficient LED Light: High-quality LED lamp with 168 light beads ensures uniform brightness and reduced energy consumption; Sturdy build for long-lasting performance, easy to install and perfect for various desk setups

Product description

Two ways to control

Easy to Install

Flexible, adjustable clip design that can support desks up to 2.3 inches thick.

Note: The clamp is only suitable for desktops smaller than 2.36 inches/5.8cm.

Adjustable Lamp Head

Flexible and easy to control, allowing you to direct the light over a wide area.

32.8FT remote control

With the remote control, you can conveniently power on the desk lamp, adjust the lighting mode, and set functions such as automatic hourly shut-off.

Applicable To Multiple Occasions

You can direct the light exactly where you need it. It provides ample and comfortable lighting for your work at home, office, studying, drawing, reading, sewing, and crafting.

    5 out of 5 stars
    The MVP of my College Years!!
    I have owned this lamp for over 2 years now, and I love it!! I have used it every night and day as a college student. It has had 0 lighting issues and 0 malfunctions in all these years. No flickering, no dimming, just perfection. It was a breeze to set up, and I love the multiple settings; it is bright enough to add extra light to my room even during daytime! Unlike other brands that I’ve tried, this lamp is very lightweight. The neck is very sturdy yet flexible and it’s strong enough to hold its lamp head up with no problem. The remote that it comes with works great, so I can change the setting while working without having to stand up from my chair. As I have said before, it has had 0 malfunctions, so it has obeyed every command when I have used its buttons or the remote to change its settings. The timer is also nice and helps me know when it’s time for bed or a good time for a break. As a bookworm, this is a must, so I don’t fall too deep into the story and then regret it in school the next morning. The setup was so easy. Because the lamp came as a whole rather than separate pieces, there was really no assembly needed. You just turn the clamp till it fits your table’s thickness. Then, you plug the cord into the lamp and your electric wall socket, and prepare for years of blissful lighting! Furthermore, because it comes as one piece, unlike other brands, it truly can turn 360-degrees or wind however you want it. Combined with its warmth to coolness light settings, it is great for taking photos when I sell things online. I cannot recommend any lamp more! I have tried other brands, and only this one has lasted me and carried me throughout my college career! I got it when I first started college, and now I’m about to graduate and it still works like new!

      All-Day Eye Comfort: Adjustable light temperatures transition smoothly from focused daylight to easy-on-the-eyes evening warm light.

      Cons:

      Overhead Clearance Required:Needs sufficient vertical and lateral space around large monitor setups to maneuver the arms.

      Desk Clutter:The included remote adds one extra accessory to manage on your workspace. Remote is an over-kill in my opinion.

      Verdict:

      A high-performing, sturdy lighting solution built for power users with multi-monitor desks. If you spend 10+ hours a day at your workstation, its versatility, wide coverage, and effortless controls make it well worth the space.

    About this Item

    • Super Bright & Eye-Caring: This LED desk lamp features a dual-head design for a wider lighting range, delivering high brightness while remaining soft and flicker-free; Reduces eye strain, making it ideal for home office, reading, studying, and long work sessions
    • Customizable Lighting & Memory Function: Offers 5 color temperatures (3000K-6500K) and 5 brightness levels (20%-100%) for personalized illumination; Smart memory function retains the last-used setting for added convenience
    • Flexible Goose-Neck & Space-Saving Design: Adjustable goose-neck allows precise light positioning; Compact clamp design saves desk space while providing bright and efficient lighting for tasks like reading, writing, crafting, and working
    • Remote & Button Control with Timer: Adjust brightness and color with a remote (up to 32.8 ft/10 m range) or on-lamp button controls; 1-hour timer function automatically turns off the light, perfect for home office setups and study sessions
    • Durable & Energy-Efficient LED Light: High-quality LED lamp with 168 light beads ensures uniform brightness and reduced energy consumption; Sturdy build for long-lasting performance, easy to install and perfect for various desk setups
